CustomField.description: How this card's visibility rules combine. ALL: every active rule must pass, so each rule adds a requirement. ANY: each active rule is one way to qualify, so passing a single rule is enough — the only way to express "audience A or audience B", since a Permission Set cannot be read from a formula. Defaults to ALL because a misread here decides who sees data, and a rule that fails to grant is safer than one that grants by accident.
CustomField.label: Rule Match Logic
